issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B (Decimal >= 28 digits; Median/StdDev/Variance/PopulationVariance semantics)
issues.evidence: Median({100000000000.01,100000000000.03,100000000000.02}) -> 100000000000.02000896 (exact 100000000000.02); Variance({100000000000.01,100000000000.03}) -> 0.00020024 (exact 0.0002); PopulationVariance -> 0.00010012 (exact 0.0001); StdDev -> 0.01415055 (exact 0.01414214). Root cause: macros/aggregate.py numeric_list casts elements to DOUBLE before list_aggregate; DuckDB var_samp/median on DECIMAL lists also downcasts to DOUBLE. Reproducers in .temp/qa/cql20_explorer/. Affects all 3 engine modes (pure SQL macro).
issues.root_cause: DOUBLE-cast lowering of DECIMAL list elements (translator static branch + SQL macros); DOUBLE ~16 sig digits destroys sub-centesimal deviations >=1e10
issues.resolution: Shifted exact-decimal lowering (deviations from first non-null element; Median = anchor + median(devs)) in _functions.py static branch (SQLArray-only at dispatch site) and macros/aggregate.py; unary +/- element-type inference. Focused tests added; aggregate suite 35/35; full gate 2832/2832 incl DQM 47/47.

issues.evidence: GeometricMean({9999999999999.0,9999999999999.0}) -> 9999999999999.006 (exact: 9999999999999.0). exp(avg(ln)) double path; ln/exp error amplification (~30*1e-16 rel) at 14-digit magnitudes. Result precision bounded by DOUBLE's 16 significant digits; exact fix needs decimal ln/exp/sqrt. Disproportionate for a LOW edge regime; small-magnitude values (spec examples) accurate.

issues.evidence: Sum((from (from {3,1,2} A0 return A0) B return B)) -> Invalid Input Error: More than one row returned by a subquery used as an expression (all 3 modes, identical SQL).
